entities.name: Nicholas I, Count of Salm-Neuburg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicholas, Count of Salm was a German soldier and an Imperial senior military commander. His greatest achievement was the defence of Vienna during the first siege by the Ottoman Empire in 1529.
